source_snapshot.procedure: Generic setup says clear logs; open Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor reading and threshold are human readable and match specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES passes FAN1_F~FAN16_F as one literal sensor name and truncates fallback SDR data; it cannot prove sixteen identities, decode F, establish tach scaling or correlate full UI/spec evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION correctly rejects aggregate proof and unsafe stimulus but primarily treats F as a fault/status suffix. The SPD prefix and paired `_R` family make a front-speed channel interpretation more plausible, while still requiring Project authority.

old_problem: DeepSeek's literal range cannot validate sixteen records, while GPT V2 risks changing coverage by recasting an SPD sensor family as fault-state telemetry. `_F` remains platform-defined; neither fault nor front may be asserted from one letter, and RPM cannot be accepted without physical/controller identity, tach scaling and contemporaneous fan-control context.
disposition_reason: Preserve this source as its own sixteen-channel speed family, distinct from the preceding `_R` family. At runtime the Project must define `_F`; if confirmed as front rotor, bind each token to that rotor and tach input, otherwise bind the documented alternative without changing the SPD speed/display purpose. Independently collect every F-labeled record and both UI rows under unchanged cooling conditions. Undefined Project bindings make execution NOT READY, not review Pending.
decision_basis: XLSX row 896, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, selection manifest, immediately paired `_R` row and the preserved V3.1 history were directly reviewed.

`SPD` plus paired `_F`/`_R` families supports a front/rear tach hypothesis more strongly than GPT V2's fault-state interpretation, but only the platform fan/controller specification may authorize that expansion.
This F-family is independent coverage: even if front and rear rotors share one physical fan assembly or PWM target, sixteen R results cannot stand in for sixteen F results.
ED-03 forbids guessed OEM/controller semantics, ED-15 requires approved state-specific limits, ED-17 retains cooling evidence and ED-20 preserves this row's sixteen unique identities.

test_case.test_name: Verify SPD_FAN1_F through SPD_FAN16_F as sixteen independently mapped speed channels
test_case.purpose: Verify each F-labeled speed sensor is separately present or has an approved defined absence, maps to the authoritative physical fan/rotor or Project-defined controller channel, and presents correct speed, units, health, supported thresholds and freshness in Dashboard and Server Health for the unchanged current cooling state.
required_package: Chassis, fan-board/controller and BMC build plus authoritative SPD_FAN and `_F`/`_R` suffix definitions
Sixteen-row F-family map to physical fan module, front rotor if confirmed or other documented channel, thermal zone, airflow direction, fan PN/serial and controller tach input
Tach pulses-per-revolution/scaling, controller/bus/channel identity and stable SDR/API/Dashboard/Server Health names
Approved state-specific RPM units/rounding/tolerance, threshold capability/values/hysteresis, health, polling/freshness and stale/no-reading rules
Current fan mode, PWM duty/target, system power/load, inlet/ambient, altitude and airflow context plus approved F/R mismatch handling
Acceptance for unfitted channels, a stopped/missing F channel, duplicate/swapped mapping and degraded cooling without fault injection
Validated protected read-only BMC/browser client and pinned immutable reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or approved manual method
test_case.test_command: Preserve SEL, BMC, kernel and thermal logs. Do not infer that F means front or fault: load the approved suffix and topology map first. Do not use `SPD_FAN1_F~SPD_FAN16_F` as one query unless the interface explicitly documents that syntax. Enumerate the complete sensor repository, resolve each exact F token separately, review the Script before use, and capture full identity, mapped physical/controller channel, RPM/value, units, health, supported threshold fields and timestamp with matching Dashboard and Server Health visual rows. Record the same-time fan mode, PWM target/duty, load and ambient/airflow state, then apply only its approved rule. Stop without automatic retry on absent, duplicate, swapped, stale or F/R-divergent evidence; do not manipulate cooling to create a fault.
test_case.expected_result: Sixteen explicit F-family outcomes are present and remain distinct from the R-family. For every applicable channel, the OOB record and both UI views agree with the approved physical/controller mapping, speed semantics, units, health, supported thresholds and freshness, and the reading meets the approved rule for its recorded state. If `_F` is not front rotor, the documented Project meaning is used without converting this passive speed case into an unapproved fault-injection test.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the approved `_F` definition, sixteen explicit independently evidenced outcomes and engineer-confirmed mapping/value/threshold/status/freshness agreement in OOB and both UI locations. A literal range, first-100-line fallback, all-healthy summary, count, R-family evidence, assumed front/fault meaning or generic RPM limit cannot pass. Missing/swapped/duplicate/stale mapping, wrong unit/scaling, out-of-rule speed or required UI/status/threshold mismatch is FAIL. Missing suffix/topology/state rules or reviewed access is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS. Dynamic fan-fault, stall/latch/clear and control-response validation is separate coverage.
safety_gate: Do not perform the generic clear-log step; preserve fan, thermal, SEL and BMC history.
Do not infer F as fault or front, and do not reuse the R-family verdict; require the Project suffix and channel map.
Do not stop/remove/reseat a fan, obstruct airflow, change fan policy/PWM, add thermal load, alter thresholds or inject a fault.
Do not guess OEM controller parameters or judge state-dependent RPM with one invariant limit.
Do not truncate evidence, expose credentials or execute an unreviewed Script; stop without automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Chassis/fan-board/controller/BMC identity and approved explanation of SPD_FAN `_F` relative to `_R`
Sixteen exact F tokens mapped to physical module/confirmed rotor-or-channel/zone/PN/serial/controller tach input with scaling
Complete separate OOB readings with speed/value, units, thresholds, state and synchronized timestamps plus corresponding Dashboard and Server Health visual evidence
Simultaneous PWM target/duty, fan mode, load, inlet/ambient, altitude and airflow plus the applied per-state rule and F/R correlation
Unfitted/missing/stopped/duplicate/swapped/stale/mismatched disposition, reviewed Script/client audit and explicit statement that no fault was induced
No-clear/no-fan-or-airflow-or-load-or-control change/no-retry proof, final cooling/BMC health and sixteen-channel engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: The method is observational. If the F meaning, channel binding or scaling is unresolved, or telemetry is stale/divergent, stop and preserve original evidence and cooling context. Obtain the authoritative controller/fan definition and repeat only under an approved read-only plan; do not stop a fan or alter cooling to disambiguate. Any separately authorized fault stimulus requires isolation, safety gates and its own recovery procedure.

source_conflict.reason: `SPD`, the UI Procedure and Criteria consistently request speed-sensor display validation. The suffix is underdefined but the source does not require a contradictory fault injection; GPT V2's fault interpretation is corrected without altering source coverage.

blocked.reason: A safe passive sixteen-record method exists. The Project fan/controller dictionary can bind the F family and its acceptance before execution.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Authoritative `_F`/`_R` meaning, sixteen physical fan/rotor-or-channel/controller/tach mappings, scaling, stable sensor/UI IDs, state-specific speed/threshold/status/freshness rules, F/R mismatch handling, cooling context and protected reviewed method.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; READ ONLY; NO FAN FAULT INJECTION OR COOLING CHANGE; SCRIPT NOT APPROVED

external_authorities.application: Pin and review before use; it cannot establish F semantics, physical rotor/channel topology, tach scaling or Project limits.
